goal: Complete and compare the E1 SFT arm across preregistered seeds 17, 29, and 43 using the frozen train split and validation protocol.
hypothesis: SFT improves greedy repair pass@1 over the pinned Qwen3-0.6B baseline across multiple random seeds; this follow-up reports the observations without treating validation as confirmatory test evidence.
acceptance: Complete SFT seeds 29 and 43 with the same two-epoch configuration, train rows, model revision, and tokenizer as seed 17; only random seed and unique run ID differ.
Save each adapter and full run manifest outside Git on the persistent training volume, then copy each adapter to the user's D:\桌面\python-fixer\outputs directory and verify SHA-256 after transfer.
Generate one non-thinking greedy completion per validation problem for each seed, with batch size 1 and max_new_tokens 512; use the same already-recorded deterministic baseline candidates.
Score every adapter's exact 32 validation candidates with the same parser, pinned gVisor image, and sandbox policy; record per-seed pass@1, paired wins, and regressions.
Leave the test split unused; label all validation results exploratory and report the three seed outcomes separately and as a descriptive mean/range.
Record observed SFT time and status; provider cost remains NOT_VERIFIED unless an authoritative billing ledger is available. Do not provision a new GPU node.
required_gates: Before each training run, verify the SFT_ONLY_GPU_PREFLIGHT is PASS for the active H200 UUID, pinned model/tokenizer hashes, train-file hash, and persistent mount.
Run the unchanged two-epoch training configuration to completion and verify the expected 50 optimizer steps, finite losses, and saved adapter/checkpoint hashes.
Verify each locally copied adapter SHA-256 equals its remote run manifest and reload it with the pinned base model before evaluation.
Use the approved separate QEMU CPU worker; its pinned gVisor runsc isolation preflight must remain PASS at 35/35 before executing candidates.
Reconcile each evaluation grid exactly to the 32 validation problem IDs and ensure no test-split IDs or outputs are present.

evidence_scope.training: OBSERVED_SFT_ONLY_PILOT; full Spec 07 replacement-node recovery and full external worker integration remain NOT_VERIFIED
evidence_scope.evaluation: EXPLORATORY_PAIRED_GREEDY_VALIDATION; not a sealed-test or confirmatory result

budget_and_retries.estimate_basis: Two additional seed-17-equivalent runs at the observed 291.4 second trainer wall time each; inference and setup time excluded.
budget_and_retries.billing_estimate_note: The H200 remains on the same active node; SSH does not expose the provider billing interval or ledger, so no yuan total is asserted.
budget_and_retries.retry_rule: Retry only after classifying an infrastructure failure; never rerun a completed candidate because of a poor score.

dependencies: Active same-node NVIDIA H200 with unchanged GPU UUID
Pinned persistent run-root mount and existing SFT-only preflight
Previously recorded baseline greedy candidates and passing 35/35 gVisor preflight
